observations: Two automotive headlights, left and right sides.
Multi-lens LED configuration with five distinct optical elements per unit.
Units are wrapped in clear protective plastic film.
Amber side reflectors are visible on the outer edges.
Internal housing features white or silver accents.
Background contains other automotive components and an unreadable shipping label.

claims.claim: The headlights is Very neat as new one
claims.evidence: The plastic wrap obscures the lens surface, preventing confirmation of scratches or scuffs, and internal electronic condition is unknown.

risks.risk: LEDs or internal control circuitry may be defective
risks.proof: A video clip showing all lighting functions (low beam, high beam, and DRL) powered on.

risks.risk: Mounting tabs or the rear plastic housing may be cracked or broken
risks.proof: Photos of the back and sides of both headlight units.

risks.risk: Lenses may have surface damage hidden by the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Clear photos of the lenses with the plastic wrap removed.

proof_requests: Video of the headlights powered on to verify all LED segments work.
Photos of the rear of the units to inspect the mounting tabs.
Photos of the lenses without the plastic wrapping.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as high-end multi-lens LED headlights. The specific 'Jewel Eye' design is a direct visual match for the Acura MDX 2018 model listed in the comparables.
